## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC business combination and TRA execution

- 2020-02-07: GS Acquisition Holdings Corp / Vertiv business combination closes; executed Tax Receivable Agreement filed at 65% to VPE Holdings, LLC (Platinum Equity affiliate), covering Additional Basis Recovery, R&D Credit, and Seller Expense Deductions (8-K)

#### Repurchase Agreement and payment restructuring

- 2021-12-31: TRA Repurchase Agreement executed, terminating the original TRA upon receipt of a fixed $100M lump-sum (vs $162M Q3 2021 fair value); filed as Exhibit 10.1 to FY2021 10-K
- 2022-06-15: Amendment No. 1 to Repurchase Agreement restructures payment schedule from $50M / $50M to $12.5M / $12.5M / $75M installments (8-K)

#### Termination on final installment

- 2022-11-30: Third installment ($75M) paid; TRA terminates with no further obligations to VPE Holdings (FY2022 10-K)

## Explanation

Vertiv Holdings Co became the PubCo of a SPAC business combination on February 7, 2020 and at close executed a Tax Receivable Agreement paying 65% of cash tax savings on three defined attributes (Additional Basis Recovery, R&D Credit, and Seller Expense Deductions) to Platinum Equity affiliate VPE Holdings, LLC; the 65% rate (rather than the Up-C-typical 85%) reflects the SPAC structure. Effective December 31, 2021 the parties signed a TRA Repurchase Agreement that terminated the original contract upon Vertiv paying a fixed $100M lump-sum, replacing the contract's full payment stream (then booked at $162M fair value) and implying a roughly $60M pre-tax gain on extinguishment. Amendment No. 1 to the Repurchase Agreement (June 15, 2022) restructured the payments from a $50M / $50M schedule into $12.5M / $12.5M / $75M installments paid on June 15, September 15, and November 30, 2022. The third installment paid in full triggered termination on November 30, 2022. See `contract_log.md` for the full Repurchase Agreement text and payment record.
